LAYER_HOTKEYS.cycleTip: Enable cycling between selectable tools in a given layer by pressing the hotkey repeatedly
LAYER_HOTKEYS.resetOnChangeTip: Always reset to using the first tool in a layer when switching to that layer via hotkey
LAYER_HOTKEYS.sidebarHotkeysTip: Register hotkeys for the tabs in the right sidebar
LAYER_HOTKEYS.combatHotkeysTip: Register hotkeys for common combat actions
LAYER_HOTKEYS.hotkeyGroupHint: Register hotkeys for each of the selectable tools in this layer
LAYER_HOTKEYS.stickyUnconstrainedTip: Remember the state of the Unconstrained Movement setting between refreshes and scene changes

cache.notes: Save the current layers and tools so that hotkeys can be bound for them as-needed on future page loads.  Core layers and tools are handled by default; this will also include layers and tools that systems and modules have added.  The changes will be reflected after the next page refresh.
cache.saveSettings: Current layers/tools saved.  Refresh the page to see the change reflected in the hotkey bindings.
cache.resetSettings: Layers/tools reset.  Refresh the page to see the change reflected in the hotkey bindings.
